description: This file defines an enum `ModelCatalogLoader` which provides functionality to load, parse, and cache a JavaScript-based model catalog for an application. It includes methods to resolve paths, sanitize JavaScript source code, evaluate it within a JavaScript context, and extract model data, with logging and caching mechanisms integrated.

methods.name: load(from:)
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the model catalog from a specified path, parses the JavaScript source, and returns sorted model choices.

methods.name: resolveDefaultPath()
methods.description: Resolves the default path for the model catalog, prioritizing cached, bundled, or node modules paths.

methods.name: resolvePath(preferred:)
methods.description: Resolves the provided preferred path, falling back to other locations if the file isn't found.

methods.name: bundleCatalogPath()
methods.description: Retrieves the path to the bundled 'models.generated.js' resource within the app bundle.

methods.name: nodeModulesCatalogPath()
methods.description: Constructs possible paths within node_modules to locate 'models.generated.js'.

methods.name: cacheCatalog(sourcePath:)
methods.description: Copies the source model catalog to a cache location.

methods.name: sanitize(source:)
methods.description: Sanitizes JavaScript source code by extracting and cleaning the 'MODELS' export, preparing it for evaluation.
